blocks.text: Galvanometer current pakarne ka aala hai. Yahan hum us ki andaruni banawat ya kaam par baat nahi karte, sirf us ke istemalat par. Yeh aksar electrical circuits mein durust paimaishon ke liye null tareeqon mein istemal hota hai. Null tareeqe mein circuit ko tab tak badla jata hai jab tak galvanometer koi jhukao na dikhaye, yaani sifar reading; yeh batata hai ke circuit mein kuch matlooba sharait poori hain, aur is halat mein galvanometer ke dono siron par electric potentials ek hain. Agarche galvanometer ki apni resistance hai, null reading par yeh kaam nahi aati, kyunke us se koi current nahi guzarta. Null tareeqa Wheatstone bridge aur potentiometer jaise bridge circuits mein aam hai.

Wheatstone bridge mein galvanometer mukhalif atraaf ke darmiyani nuqton ke darmiyan jora jata hai; badalne wali resistance ko tab tak badla jata hai jab tak galvanometer koi jhukao na dikhaye, us nuqte par bridge balanced hai aur na-maloom resistance maloom resistances ki nisbat se nikalti hai. Potentiometer mein null tareeqa na-maloom voltage ko potentiometer ke resistance taar par lagaye maloom hawala voltage se muwazna kar ke napta hai; taar par rabta karne ke liye galvanometer aur jockey istemal hote hain, aur null nuqte par jockey aur taar ke sire ke darmiyan potential difference na-maloom voltage ke barabar hota hai, to jockey ki jagah na-maloom voltage ki paimaish deti hai.
Null tareeqon mein galvanometer ke fawaid

items: Null tareeqa paimaish par galvanometer ki andaruni resistance ka asar khatam karta hai, jis se readings zyada durust hoti hain.
Galvanometers bohat hassas hain aur 10^-6 ampere ke darje ke bohat chhote currents pakar sakte hain.
'Koi jhukao nahi' balance ki seedhi aur saaf shart batata hai, jis se null nuqta pehchanna aasan hai.

blocks.prompt: Galvanometer ki resistance null paimaish par asar kyun nahi karti?
blocks.explanation: Null nuqte par galvanometer se koi current nahi behta, to us ki resistance par koi potential girawat nahi; balance ki shart sirf doosri resistances ya lambaiyon par munhasir hai, galvanometer ki apni resistance jo bhi ho.

items: Galvanometer: current pakarta hai; null tareeqon mein, circuit ko be-jhukao hone tak badalna, jab us ke dono sire ek potential par hon aur us ki resistance kaam na aaye. Wheatstone bridge aur potentiometer. Fawaid: resistance ka asar khatam, taqreeban 10^-6 A pakarta hai, saaf balance nuqta.
